name: cache
description: Bounded caching with pluggable eviction for boru, to be exposed as the single `Cache` namespace. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: cache.aql exports an empty namespace. See DESIGN.md.

conventions.call: forward args, receiver (the cache) LAST: `Cache.verb ...args c`. Piping `c Cache.verb ...args end` binds identically; only receiver-first-all-forward misbinds.
conventions.scope: This is an EFFECT MEMOIZER, not a general-purpose cache. A map read costs ~63us on this runtime, so caching work cheaper than that makes the program slower. Wrap network calls, file reads and expensive parses.
conventions.keys: Cache keys are Strings: boru map keys must be String or Atom.
conventions.time: The library never reads the clock (`clock` is a gated policy scope). If TTL lands, the caller supplies the timestamp.
conventions.memoize: There is deliberately no `memoize` word: passing a function across a module boundary hits boru's free-word scope defect (design/FUNCTION-VALUE-SCOPE.0.md).
